entries.name: JavaScript
entries.note: No import: the adapter puts the stereotypes in scope before it loads the handler, the same way Tac makes @onMount available to a companion. Decorators need a runtime that transpiles them — Bun or Deno, selected with --javascript-runtime. Node rejects them at parse time and its own documentation says it will not polyfill a Stage 3 proposal.

entries.note: No shebang and no envelope: the JavaScript adapter imports a yon.ts the same way it imports a yon.js, so the two are one shape. The runtime has to read TypeScript — Bun and Deno do, Node does not.

entries.note: The owned Python adapter places stereotypes in builtins before loading the captured server tree. The example uses Python namespace packages, so no __init__.py markers are needed under the typed service and repository directories.

entries.name: PHP
entries.note: PHP layers are required by their project-relative path. Tachyon captures the server tree and appends its owned protocol runtime; the application supplies only its annotated classes and HTTP methods.

files.name: server/routes/orders/yon.php
files.code:
<?php
// PHP layers are required by their project-relative path. Tachyon captures
// the server tree and runs the handler with its owned protocol runtime.
require_once 'server/services/orders.php';

#[Controller]
class OrdersController
{
    public static function GET(YonRequest $request): YonResponse
    {
        return YonResponse::json(json_encode(['orders' => OrderService::list()]));
    }
}

files.name: server/services/orders.php
files.code:
<?php
require_once 'server/repositories/orders.php';

#[Service]
class OrderService
{
    public static function list(): array
    {
        return OrderRepository::all();
    }
}

files.name: server/repositories/orders.php
files.code:
<?php

#[Repository]
class OrderRepository
{
    public static function all(): array
    {
        return [['sku' => 'anvil', 'level' => 4]];
    }
}

entries.name: Java
entries.note: Java uses one compiled source file per route. Keep the controller, service and repository classes together in yon.java, as below: separate compiled layer files are not imported yet. Tachyon supplies the protocol entry point, annotations and Json helpers.
